bullets.text: Weight-Loss Drugs Reduce Risks - **Ozempic** shows potential to lower heart attack risk in obese patients with cardiovascular disease.
Apple's App Store Monopoly Case - A UK tribunal ruling could cost **Apple** nearly $2 billion for unfair developer commissions.
CMA Designates Apple & Google - **Apple** and **Google** now have strategic market status, leading to potential new regulations.
CarPlay Gets Messages Update - **iOS 26** introduces tapbacks support for **CarPlay**, enhancing user experience.
Portable Cinema for Apple TV - **Aurzen BOOM Air** projector offers impressive performance for under $300.
Ecovacs Robot Lawn Mower Review - The **Goat A3000** offers advanced mapping and cutting technology for lawn care.
Apple Watch Hypertension Feature - **watchOS 26** brings hypertension notifications to select older **Apple Watch** models.
Intel's Foundry Business Focus - **Intel** sees recovery with strategic investments and prioritizes AI over consumer chips.
EA Partners with Stability AI - **EA** collaborates with **Stability AI** to integrate AI into game development processes.
Turbo AI Hits 5 Million Users - College dropouts launch **Turbo AI**, achieving rapid growth and profitability.
